p: Victoria Street is the spine of Grimsby's pedestrianised town centre, right beside Freshney Place, so this is about as central as it gets.

Grimsby is a town built on fishing, and that story is told brilliantly at the Fishing Heritage Centre on Alexandra Dock, a short walk from here. The Grimsby Dock Tower, the tall brick landmark you can see from all over town, stands over the docks. Admiral is an adult gaming centre, which means strictly 18+, and this branch suits a daytime stop. If you've got the family with you, Cleethorpes seafront, with its proper seaside amusements, is only a few minutes away by bus, train or car.
